hint: Hover over or tap a highlighted part to see what TYPO3 derives from the part.

parts.title: Type
parts.text: The type sets the HTTP method of the route and the hints of the MCP tool.

parts.title: Name
parts.text: The name is the identifier of the action and sets its route `/typo3/api/my-extension/page/{uid}/titles`. The name of the MCP tool is `fetch_my_extension_page_by_uid_titles`.

parts.match: summary: 'Fetch the titles of a page'
parts.title: Summary
parts.text: The summary documents the action for developers in OpenAPI and for AI agents in the tool list.

parts.title: Scopes
parts.text: The caller must have all listed scopes. Otherwise TYPO3 rejects the call.

parts.title: Parameters
parts.text: The parameters define the input JSON Schema. TYPO3 reads the values from the route, the query string or the JSON body, validates them and converts them to PHP types.

parts.title: ActionContext
parts.text: TYPO3 passes the `ActionContext` automatically and keeps the `ActionContext` out of the schema. The `ActionContext` holds the TYPO3 context, the user, the translator, the request and the granted scopes.

parts.title: Return type
parts.text: PHPDoc types such as `list<string>` or array shapes define the output schema. TYPO3 validates the result before TYPO3 returns the result.

parts.match: @throws NotFoundError if the page does not exist
parts.title: Declared errors
parts.text: The action must declare every error with `@throws`. TYPO3 returns `NotFoundError` as `404` and `PermissionDeniedError` as `403`, and documents both errors in OpenAPI.
